placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
The Curzon makes a local cinema trip feel like an occasion. Pick a film from the current programme and enjoy a shared story in a building with a long connection to the town.

Our family idea: let children help choose an age-appropriate screening, then talk about a favourite scene on the way home. For a first cinema visit, consider the running time as well as the film certificate.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Families who enjoy films and a calmer indoor outing.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Cinema screenings and a box office; check the access information when booking.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Public car parks off Great Western Road are a short walk away; check their current charges.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Book for a specific screening. Check the film certificate, running time and any access requirements before choosing seats.

placevisitmap.travelNote: Public car parks off Great Western Road are a short walk away; check their current charges. Use this postcode for the arrival area, then follow local signs to the entrance. Google Maps can use your current location, or you can enter a starting point.
